title: Inferring morphism record
description: Morphism: prompt × model → utterance. Aperiodic-regime morphism placed inside aperiodic-articulation-category; variance: restriction of the articulating-class morphism to the LLM-endpoint enactor. Given a prompt (a claim schema-document, the outgoing message) and an llm-model (endpoint + model references), inferring calls the endpoint and returns an utterance whose token (slot 0) carries the call provenance (originating prompt, endpoint, model, transactionTime) as a schema-doc, and whose claim (slot 1) carries the reply text as a schema-doc. The reply IS an utterance — it composes directly into the descent via articulating.
